# components/calendar

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/calendar/calendar.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Calendar } from "@tundralibs/ui/calendar"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Calendar`

```ts
Calendar(props: CalendarProps): Html
```

A month of events: a 7-column grid with a weekday header, leading and
trailing days from the neighbouring months muted, today ringed
(`aria-current="date"`), events as tone-coloured chips stacked in their
day (multi-day events fill each day), the overflow folded into a
"+N more" button calendar.js unfolds. Below 768px the grid becomes a
list of the days that have events. Month navigation is links the
server answers (a rAPId swap with `target`), so the whole thing works
without JS.

## Types

### `CalendarTone`

- `"neutral"`
- `"accent"`
- `"success"`
- `"warning"`
- `"danger"`
- `"info"`

### `CalendarWeekStart`

Which day begins the week.

- `"sunday"`
- `"monday"`

### `CalendarEvent`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `date` | `string` | yes | ISO day (`2026-10-14`). |
| `end` | `string` |  | ISO day of a multi-day event's last day; it fills every day in between. |
| `title` | `string` | yes |  |
| `href` | `string` |  | The chip links here. |
| `tone` | `CalendarTone` |  |  |
| `time` | `string` |  | Shown before the title (`"09:30"`). |

### `CalendarProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Required: the region a month swap replaces, and the base of every inner id. |
| `year` | `number` | yes |  |
| `month` | `number` | yes | 0-based, like `Date`. |
| `events` | `CalendarEvent[]` | yes |  |
| `today` | `string` |  | ISO day that gets the today ring. Omit and no day is marked — the server knows the date, not this template. |
| `weekStart` | `CalendarWeekStart` |  |  |
| `buildHref` | `(year: number, month: number) => string` |  | Prev/next month links — `(year, month) => url`; implement with `withQuery()` so other params survive. |
| `target` | `string` |  | Make the month links rAPId swaps of this selector (`#<id>`, outer, pushed to history) instead of full navigations. |
| `buildDayHref` | `(iso: string) => string` |  | A day number becomes a link here (`(iso) => url`) — a day view, a "new event on" form. |
| `maxEvents` | `number` |  | Chips shown per day before the rest fold into "+N more". @default 3 |
| `labels` | `{ today?: string; more?: string; prev?: string; next?: string }` |  | Wording; `{n}` in `more` stands for the number. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  | Extra attributes on the root; a `class` merges. |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### The team's month, month links as swaps

`buildHref` answers prev/next with the same route; with `target` they swap the calendar in place and push history.

```ts
Calendar({
  id: "team-calendar",
  year: 2026,
  month: 9,
  today: "2026-10-14",
  events: [
    { id: "1", date: "2026-10-06", end: "2026-10-09", title: "Offsite", tone: "info" },
    { id: "2", date: "2026-10-14", time: "11:00", title: "Design review", tone: "success", href: "/events/2" },
    { id: "3", date: "2026-10-22", time: "08:00", title: "Payroll", tone: "danger" },
  ],
  buildHref: (y, m) => `/calendar?month=${y}-${String(m + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`,
  target: "#team-calendar",
  buildDayHref: (iso) => `/events/new?on=${iso}`,
})
```

## Behaviour

`components/calendar/calendar.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-calendar-more`.
